quickzoom.configuration.title: QuickZoom
Enable cinematic camera (F8 smooth camera) while zooming. Default: ON
quickzoom.configuration.enableSmoothZoom: Gradually change FOV like a telescope. Disable for instant switch. Default: OFF
quickzoom.configuration.smoothSpeed.tool: How fast the FOV transitions (0.01 = slow, 1.0 = fast). Default: 0.1
